title: The Clock of Nagasaki's harbor
author: Ansel Joubert
blurb: Astrid Winterbourne, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
